title: entity_changed payload
description: Payload of the AG-UI CUSTOM event named 'entity_changed', emitted by the agent after a backend tool mutates an entity. Clients use it to reconcile their GraphQL caches.

typename.description: GraphQL __typename of the changed entity, e.g. 'Task'

id.description: Entity id as exposed by the GraphQL schema

scope.description: Coarse invalidation scope. Mobile screens subscribe to the bus filtered by the scope(s) they render; v1 uses the single scope 'tasks'.
